coordinateSystem: top-left origin; x grows right; y grows down
revisionReason: Expand tailMotion to contain the full union of the idle tail and raised-tail component; attentionHead and tailRootAnchor are unchanged from v1.

attentionHead.role: Only region allowed to change between idle and attention-base.

tailMotion.role: Union area reserved for removing the complete idle tail and writing one raised tail.

tailRootAnchor.role: Hard anchor that must remain connected and pixel-stable between attention-base and attention-tail.
